title: 3.3 Dev-A : Widget shows ISF ??
body:
Last Dev. I have a "normal" AutoSens information on the AAPS UI but a strange information on the AAPS widget. It is as if it was showing an ISF change but I don't use _Variable sensitivity_ or DynISF.
